# Role: scout (read-only recon)

Repo: /home/aurel/Documents/github/pi-workflows (GUARD: verify pwd + git toplevel — toplevel = repo root OR a <repo>/.git/subagents/** worktree). Wrong landing → WORKER_BLOCKER, never proceed. Read AGENTS.md first.

TASK 1 of .workflows/plan.md (plan 20261102-052): map how judge.mjs is consumed today (who imports ask(), who passes fetchImpl, where audit lines land) so the orchestration task can reuse the client without re-deciding its shape. Contract: none — scout packs are recon-only; deliver findings to .workflows/LOG.md via the orchestrator. Upstream tasks: none.

## Context pack
- scripts/judge.mjs — ask(), translate(), mapAnswers(), audit path
- scripts/eval-golden.mjs — the closest existing eval runner pattern
- tests/judge.test.ts — the fake-fetchImpl test precedent (zero network)
- Known trap: do not propose new judge.mjs surface; the task is a map of what exists

## Boundaries
Allowed: none — read-only recon, no file writes anywhere. Forbidden: any write, any install, any commit.

Budget: 25 tool calls (scout doctrine default). Judge/API cap: none.

TDD law: failing test first for any code change — recon writes no code; if the orchestrator asks for a probe script anyway, bun test stays green.

Verify: your findings list every ask() call site with file:line and the audit-file path — grep -rn "ask({" scripts/ tests/ must match your list exactly.

## Report format
## Findings (call-site map) / ## Interfaces to reuse / ## Traps / ## Open questions. Per-line evidence: every call site cited as file:line — no bare assertions.

Recon only. The context pack above replaces discovery, not the map.
